title: Audit Signal Correlator for RBACv2 + SSO — SLOs, Alerts, and Postmortem Actions
creator: Asha Kumar
description:
Problem: After the Jan 2025 elevated-latency incident, we found multiple blind spots between RBACv2 decision logs, SSO session events, and the central audit sink. High-cardinality identifiers (session_id, admin_principal, request_id) were present across services but not correlated consistently in the ingestion path, which made root cause triage slow and caused delayed detection of anomalous admin activity.

Goal: Build an "audit signal correlator" that enriches and joins RBAC and SSO telemetry in the ingestion path so that: (1) audit events are queryable by unified keys, (2) SLOs for audit delivery and alerting are meaningful, and (3) post-incident retrospectives produce actionable follow-ups instead of hunting for missing joins.

Scope: This ticket covers design, instrumentation changes, alert rules, and the postmortem action items required to make auth/audit observability reliable for production. Implementation will touch the audit-ingest pipeline, the RBAC decision service, the SSO proxy, and Grafana dashboards.

Out of scope: full retention policy redesign, legal/compliance retention approval (will be a dependent follow-up), downstream analytics pipelines that consume the enriched stream (separate EPIC).
acceptance_criteria: A streaming enrichment layer exists that consistently attaches unified_correlation_id to RBAC decision logs and SSO session events before they are written to the audit topic.
Audit ingestion SLO defined and instrumented: 99.9% of audit events are ingested and available in the central index within 30s of event emission.
Grafana dashboard shows correlated flows (session -> decisions -> API requests) and new alert panels for SLO burn and sudden increases in 'denied by RBAC' rate.
Runbook updated with a playbook for correlation failures, including steps to pivot to raw logs and ephemeral joins.
Postmortem follow-ups tracked as child tasks with owners and due dates.
tasks: Design enrichment contract and unified_correlation_id format — proposal in Confluence (confluence.redwood.internal/space/AUTH/SignalCorrelator).
Add correlation header propagation to SSO proxy (PR #http://github.com/redwood-inference/ssoproxy/pull/462).
Instrument RBACv2 decision service to emit request_id and session_id in structured audit payloads (PR #http://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/pull/1210).
Implement streaming enrichment job (Kafka Streams / Flink) to join and dedupe events, write to audit-enriched topic.
Create Grafana panels and Alertmanager rules; test in staging with replayed incident traffic.
Author runbook and tabletop scenarios; schedule on-call training session.
Validate SLO signal in Canaries and run a 48-hour observational window before alerting thresholds go to prod.
comments: 2025-01-11 - Asha Kumar: Kickoff meeting notes added to Confluence. Agreed to use a lightweight unified_correlation_id (sha1(session_id || request_id)) to avoid length explosion in kafka keys.

2025-01-15 - Miguel Ortega: Pushed initial propagator code for the SSO proxy in branch feature/correlation-header. See PR draft: http://github.com/redwood-inference/ssoproxy/pull/462. Needs security review before merge.

2025-01-20 - Lynn Park (Security): Recommend HMAC of session_id with per-cluster salt to avoid exposing raw session identifiers in downstream non-authorized sinks. We're okay as long as the enrichment job retains mapping in a protected store.

2025-01-24 - Miguel Ortega: RBAC decision service PR opened to include session_id and request_id in structured payloads. Benchmark shows <2% p50 latency increase for decision path; will gate behind feature flag. PR: http://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/pull/1210

2025-01-28 - Observability: Draft Grafana dashboard posted: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ABcd123/auth-audit-correlator. Includes panels for ingestion latency, correlation failure rate, and per-principal denial spikes.

2025-01-30 - Incident retro note: When we replayed Jan incident, correlation failed for ~0.8% of events due to message key mismatches (old proxies didn't emit request_id). Action: backfill proxies and add linting test for header propagation.
2025-02-02 - Miguel Ortega: Enrichment Flink job PoC successful in staging; dedupe window set to 5s. Observed out-of-order messages benefit from 7s watermark. Moving to canary.
2025-02-04 - Asha Kumar: Security review requested; Lynn to confirm storage protections for the mapping store. Scheduling on-call tabletop for 2025-02-10 to validate playbook.
